findings.observedBehavior: Mommy Poppins exposes an event date bar with forward date browsing and calendar pickers for event discovery.
findings.classScoutEquivalent: ClassScout has `This Week` and upcoming rendering but not a first-class date-bar event browser.
findings.recommendationReason: High family-discovery value with bounded implementation scope if built as a GDS-compliant public browse extension.

findings.observedBehavior: Mommy Poppins exposes explicit route-level filters for free events and deals inside the calendar surface.
findings.classScoutEquivalent: ClassScout does not expose price-sensitive event filters as a first-class discovery control.
findings.recommendationReason: Useful for parent planning, but should only land after a real event surface exists.

findings.capabilityName: Structured route taxonomy for search surfaces
findings.observedBehavior: Mommy Poppins publishes explicit route-level search targets and region maps in client-side settings.
findings.classScoutEquivalent: ClassScout has discovery feature flags and scarcity targets but not a documented route-taxonomy contract for external source capture.
findings.recommendationReason: Useful mainly as an internal data/operations idea, not a direct end-user feature.

findings.observedBehavior: Mommy Poppins Business Listings | Mommy Poppins - Things to Do with Kids Sorry, you need to enable JavaScript to visit this website.
findings.classScoutEquivalent: ClassScout has ingest/admin tooling but no public provider self-submission funnel.
findings.recommendationReason: Operationally valuable for future supply growth, but only after moderation and quality gates are explicit.

findings.observedBehavior: Mommy Poppins directory pages ship map-marker payloads for browseable business discovery.
findings.classScoutEquivalent: ClassScout has provider map support inside profiles, but not map-first directory discovery.
findings.recommendationReason: Potentially useful, but lower priority than event/date browsing because ClassScout already has limited map support.

findings.observedBehavior: Mommy Poppins provides a dedicated article/search surface with paged discovery and filtered guides.
findings.classScoutEquivalent: ClassScout has neighborhood-guide pages but not a dedicated editorial search surface.
findings.recommendationReason: Useful once ClassScout accumulates enough editorial volume; not a near-term priority over catalog operations.
